serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Intelliworx offers a Platform to automate complex business, workflow, application management, and forms/document solutions. This Platform provides the ability to simplify complex data collection processes into intelligent interviews that can be combined to create complete end to end business solutions. This is done by collecting information from the public or employees through adaptive interviews to ensure accuracy, completeness, and simplicity. Once information is collected and submitted, appropriate stakeholders are notified for review, approval, and correction as needed. The information can be used in future sessions or integrated into other business solutions and systems of records.
